question: Can the unordered-orientation model jointly reproduce mature MSM HIV-diagnosis and AIDS-diagnosis anchors, emphasizing the 2000-2015 treatment era and the post-2015 forecasting state?
success_criterion: At least one fresh-seed primary confirmation pass under the frozen 13-target rule. Sensitivity-only passes are reported but never promoted.

decisions_recorded.orientation: Heterosexual_Male remains fixed at 1.0; orient_female and orient_msm independently vary over 0.2-5.0 with no behavioral ordering constraint.
decisions_recorded.hiv_window: Tier-1 SHM MSM HIV diagnoses are eligible for primary calibration from 1996 onward; 1996 is retained as an early anchor.
decisions_recorded.aids_window: Mature Tier-1 RIVM/SHM MSM AIDS diagnoses are primary from 2000 onward. Pre-2000 AIDS observations remain visible as cross-validation/structural diagnostics because they come from the older voluntary Health Inspectorate registry and have an uncertain mapping to the model proxy.
decisions_recorded.forecast_windows: The search objective gives equal group treatment to diagnoses 1996-2015, AIDS 2000-2015, diagnoses after 2015 and AIDS after 2015. The 2015 seam is counted once, in the earlier window.
decisions_recorded.model_discrepancy: Primary target-relative discrepancy sigma is 10% of the observed target. A 20% sensitivity is reported only and never changes primary acceptance.
decisions_recorded.activity_interaction: No orientation-by-activity interaction is added in this run. Existing activity-stratified outputs remain passive structural diagnostics.

limitations: The AIDS observation function is an assumption: aids_first_diagnosis_proxy_msm combines diagnosed chronic-to-AIDS progression and HIV diagnosis while already in AIDS.
V_obs is underivable for mature RIVM MSM AIDS counts; zero V_obs biases toward over-exclusion.
The 10% discrepancy is a declared assumption, not an empirically estimated mapping-error distribution.
The four equal objective groups are a search-ranking heuristic only; primary acceptance remains target-level maximum implausibility.
A bounded 2,048-vector search in 33 dimensions is not proof of global feasibility or impossibility.
No output may be called a posterior, credible interval or final calibration ensemble.

discrepancy.rationale: Preserves the predeclared primary allowance used before the target-window decision; not tuned to obtain survivors.

sensitivity_discrepancies.label: target_relative_20pct
sensitivity_discrepancies.rationale: Structural mapping sensitivity only; never promotes a candidate into the primary accepted set.

run_settings.note: Fresh common-random-number seeds 200000-200004 are shared across candidates. Confirmation uses separate seeds 200100-200119.

post_run_report_required: binding targets and signed conflicts by forecasting window
pre-2000 RIVM MSM AIDS cross-validation residuals
variance-contract stability on fresh confirmation seeds
